description: Brown-Forman Corporation, incorporated under the laws of the State of Delaware in 1933 as successor to a business founded in 1870 as a partnership and later incorporated under the laws of the Commonwealth of Kentucky in 1901, primarily manufactures, distills, bottles, imports, exports, markets and sells a wide variety of beverage alcohol products under recognized brands. It employs approximately 4,900 people on six continents, including approximately 1,900 people in the United States and 700 people in Louisville, Kentucky, home of its world headquarters, and according to International Wine & Spirit Research it is the largest American-owned premium-plus spirits company. It is a controlled company under New York Stock Exchange rules because the Brown family owns more than 50 percent of its voting stock.
